- [Glossary](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html)

# Model Management

The Tryll server treats models as first-class, named resources. Every model it can load is declared in a single catalog file, `models.json`, that the server reads at startup. Clients discover, download, load, and unload models over the [wire protocol](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/wire-protocol.html); the server handles all disk I/O, HuggingFace downloads, and backend-specific loading.

This page is the reference for:

- The [`models.json`](#modelsjson) schema that tells the server what exists and how to find it.
- The [model lifecycle](#lifecycle) wire-protocol flow: `ListModels` → `DownloadModel` → `LoadModel` / `UnloadModel`.
- The [status enum](#model-status) reported per-model.
- The [retention modes](#retention-modes) that control memory occupancy.

Server-wide model settings (download directory, catalog path) live in [`server-config.json`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/server-configuration.html).

Models must be acquired explicitly

`CreateAgent`, `CreateEmbeddedStringStorage`, and `CreateVoiceInput` fail fast if a referenced model is not already on disk — the server does not download it for you. Run `ListModels` → `DownloadModel` yourself, or acquire the model from the editor Model Manager, before referencing it.

______________________________________________________________________

## `models.json` and user catalogs

Default base catalog: `data/models.json`, configurable via `models_catalog_path` in `server-config.json`. This file is **shipped by Tryll** — do not edit it; package updates overwrite it. A missing, unreadable, or invalid **base** catalog is fatal: the process does not listen.

Plugin projects point at their own catalog from Project Settings (Unity: Tryll Client → Custom Models; Unreal: Plugins → Tryll Client → Models). Any file name, any path inside the project. Empty means no extra file. The plugin passes that file as `--user-models-path`. Set it before the server's first launch, or call the setter while a server is running to restart it (the open session is dropped). A packaged game copies the saved file to `Server/data/user-catalog/` and copies relative `chat_template_file` values beside that copy. The editor uses the project file, so those relative paths resolve in place.

Running the server yourself, pass `--user-models-path` or set `user_models_catalog_path`. The default path is a sibling `user_models.json` of the base catalog. That file is not shipped; a missing file is silent. A broken user file is skipped and the server still starts; duplicate model names or shared-asset ids against the shipped catalog skip only that entry (the shipped entry wins). Extra `models.d/*.json` files are loaded the same way when that directory exists. The install does not create it. Validate with `tryll_server --check-catalogs`.

### Top-level structure

```
{
    "shared_model_assets": [
        { ... }
    ],
    "models": [
        { ... },
        { ... }
    ]
}
```

`shared_model_assets` is optional. Each asset is a file set several models share, such as the SNAC decoder: `id`, `huggingface_repo`, and `files`, each with `path`, `size_bytes` and a 64-hex-digit `sha256`. A model names an asset from its `dependencies`; every such id must resolve.

### Model descriptor fields

| Field              | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`             | string | Yes      | Human-readable model name. This is the identifier used everywhere on the wire: `CreateAgentRequest.default_model_name`, `DownloadModelRequest.model_name`, `LoadModelRequest.model_name`. Must be unique within the catalog. |
| `model_type`       | string | No       | `"embedding"`, `"stt"`, `"tts"`, or `"vad"`. **Omit for language models** — language is the implicit default.                                                                                                                |
| `audience`         | string | No       | Informational visibility hint surfaced to editor clients via `ListModels` (`"public"`, `"experimental"`, `"internal"`). Not consumed by the server.                                                                          |
| `hidden`           | bool   | No       | When `true`, the entry is omitted from `ListModels`.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `default_sampling` | object | No       | Default sampling params for this model. Sampling params set on a node take precedence. Absent fields fall back to built-in defaults listed below. Ignored for non-language models.                                           |
| `variants`         | array  | Yes      | One entry per file set. Every variant of one model must use the same [inference engine](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#inference-engine) — the catalog is rejected otherwise.                     |

### `default_sampling` fields

| Field               | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `temperature`       | float  | `0.7`   | Sampling temperature; higher = more random.                                                           |
| `top_p`             | float  | `1.0`   | Nucleus sampling threshold. `1.0` disables.                                                           |
| `top_k`             | int    | `0`     | Top-K sampling cut-off. `0` disables.                                                                 |
| `min_p`             | float  | `0.05`  | Min-P filter. `0.0` disables.                                                                         |
| `repeat_penalty`    | float  | `1.0`   | Penalty for repeating tokens. `1.0` disables.                                                         |
| `presence_penalty`  | float  | `0.0`   | OpenAI-style presence penalty. `0.0` disables.                                                        |
| `frequency_penalty` | float  | `0.0`   | OpenAI-style frequency penalty. `0.0` disables.                                                       |
| `max_tokens`        | int    | `758`   | Maximum generated [tokens](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#token) per turn. |
| `seed`              | uint32 | `0`     | RNG seed. `0` selects a random seed per turn.                                                         |

### `variants` entry fields

| Field                | Type            | Required              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | --------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `engine`             | string          | Yes                   | Which [inference engine](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#inference-engine) runs this model. Implemented engines: `"llama-cpp"` (language, embedding, and SNAC TTS), `"sherpa-onnx"` (STT / TTS / VAD) and `"onnx-runtime"` (Chatterbox TTS, internal). The server takes a model's engine from here, never from the session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `local_path`         | string          | No                    | Path to a directory containing the model file(s). Combined with `files[0]`. Takes priority over `path` and `downloads.json`. **Dev only:** must resolve inside the process storage root. Outside paths are ignored with a warning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `path`               | string          | No                    | Legacy relative path under `models_root`. Fallback when neither `local_path` nor a `downloads.json` entry resolves.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `huggingface_repo`   | string          | No                    | HuggingFace repository slug (`"owner/repo"`). Required for downloads. Empty means the model cannot be downloaded over the wire — it must already be on disk via `local_path`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `files`              | array of string | No                    | Filenames for this variant. For HuggingFace, these are downloaded from `huggingface_repo`; for local, resolved relative to `local_path`. Empty disables both download and resolution.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `context_size`       | int             | No                    | Override the engine's default context window (in [tokens](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#token)). `0` or absent uses the engine default — currently 8192 for `llama.cpp`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kv_cache_type`      | string          | No                    | `llama.cpp` KV-cache dtype: `"f16"`, `"q8_0"`, or `"q4_0"`. Default `"q8_0"` (≈half the KV VRAM vs F16). Ignored by other engines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `chat_template_file` | string          | No                    | `llama.cpp` only. Path to a Jinja chat-template file that replaces the GGUF's own embedded template. Relative paths resolve against the directory of the catalog file that declares them. A packaged Unity or Unreal build copies those relative files next to the staged user catalog. Use this when a model's own GGUF conversion ships a template that doesn't render tool definitions — see [Tool Calling](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/concepts/tool-calling.html#not-every-model-can-call-tools) — even though the model itself may support tool calling. |
| `tool_call_support`  | string          | Yes (language models) | Advisory capability declaration: `"supported"` or `"unsupported"`. Required on every language-model variant (the server rejects the catalog otherwise) and not allowed on other model types. Shown in the Unity/Unreal Model Manager detail pane and returned by `ListModels`, so you can pick a tool-capable model before downloading it. Advisory only: whether a `ToolCall` node accepts the model is still decided at agent creation from the model's own chat template.                                                                                         |
| `disable_thinking`   | bool            | No                    | `llama.cpp` only. Suppresses chain-of-thought by toggling the template's `enable_thinking`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `use_jinja`          | bool            | No                    | `llama.cpp` only. `false` reverts to the legacy C-API chat-template path instead of the Jinja engine.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `reasoning_budget`   | int             | No                    | `llama.cpp` only. Hard cap on thinking tokens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

**STT / TTS variant fields:**

| Field              | Type            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | --------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stt_family`       | string          | STT      | STT model family (e.g. `"whisper"`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `stt_recognizer`   | string          | No       | Recognizer sub-type when a family has more than one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `tts_family`       | string          | TTS      | TTS family. Sherpa-ONNX: `"supertonic"` or `"pocket"` — every other Sherpa family (VITS/Piper, Kokoro, Kitten, Matcha, ZipVoice) fails to load. llama.cpp SNAC: `"orpheus"` or `"maya1"`. ONNX Runtime: `"chatterbox"`. See [TTS Models](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/tts-models.html).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `tts_files`        | object          | TTS      | Named file map for the TTS bundle (e.g. `duration_predictor`, `text_encoder`, `vocoder`, `voice_style`, or `gguf` for SNAC) rather than the flat `files` array.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `tts_lang`         | string          | No       | Default synthesis language for a multilingual TTS model (e.g. `"en"`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `dependencies`     | object          | No       | Role → shared-asset id. SNAC entries declare `"snac_decoder": "snac-24khz-decoder"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `tts_capabilities` | object          | No       | Advertised controls: booleans `voice_description`, `delivery_instruction`, `reference_voice`, `speed`, `language_per_call`, `expressiveness` (Chatterbox exaggeration); `num_speakers` (int, `0` = not advertised); plus `voice_presets` and `inline_tags` (each tag's `verification` is `verified` or `declared`). TTS models only. Editors use it to show only the [voice profile](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/voice-profile.html) fields a model accepts, and the server uses it to check the voice of an agent that never speaks (no model loaded). For a speaking agent the loaded engine is authoritative. Every shipped TTS entry declares it. |
| `languages`        | array of string | No       | Language codes the model supports: lowercase, 2–3 letters, no duplicates. Not allowed on language models. Drives the session-locale check (`3017`) and `ModelInfo.languages`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `num_threads`      | int             | No       | Thread count for the sherpa-onnx, SNAC or Chatterbox session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Memory placement is not a catalog field (an unknown key such as `memory_placement` is ignored). Set it per session with `CreateSession`'s `placement_hints`, per load with `LoadModelRequest.placement`, or with the Model Manager's **Placement** control.

Per-agent voice settings (`speaker_id`, `speed`, `lang`, `reference_voice`, `voice_description`, delivery modes) are fields of the agent's [voice profile](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/voice-profile.html), and the chunking knobs (`min_sentence_chars`, `first_chunk_max_chars`) are **node** params. Neither is a catalog field — see [Add Voice Output to an Agent](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/add-voice-to-an-agent.html).

### Minimal example — user-provided model

```
{
    "models": [
        {
            "name": "My Local Model",
            "variants": [
                {
                    "engine":            "llama-cpp",
                    "local_path":        "models/my-local-gguf",
                    "files":             ["my-model.gguf"],
                    "tool_call_support": "unsupported"
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```

### Downloadable example — HuggingFace + tuned sampling

```
{
    "models": [
        {
            "name": "Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M)",
            "default_sampling": {
                "temperature":    0.6,
                "top_p":          0.9,
                "top_k":          50,
                "min_p":          0.05,
                "repeat_penalty": 1.2
            },
            "variants": [
                {
                    "engine":            "llama-cpp",
                    "huggingface_repo":  "bartowski/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF",
                    "files":             ["Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf"],
                    "tool_call_support": "supported"
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```

### Embedding models

Models with `"model_type": "embedding"` are declared the same way and referenced by name from [embedded string storages](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/embedded-string-storage.html) and from [Retrieve node](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/retrieve.html) params. Their sampling fields are ignored; only the file resolution and engine fields matter.

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifecycle

The wire-protocol flow for putting a model under a running agent:

```
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as Server
    C->>S: ListModelsRequest
    S-->>C: ListModelsResponse([ModelInfo])
    alt status == Absent
        C->>S: DownloadModelRequest(name)
        S-->>C: DownloadProgress × N
        S-->>C: DownloadComplete(success=true)
    end
    C->>S: LoadModelRequest(name)
    S-->>C: LoadModelResponse
    C->>S: CreateAgentRequest(default_model_name=name, ...)
    S-->>C: CreateAgentResponse(agent_id)
    note over C,S: Agent runs turns...
    C->>S: UnloadModelRequest(name)
    S-->>C: Ack
```

Key rules:

- **You do not have to call `LoadModelRequest` explicitly.** An agent whose graph references a not-yet-loaded language / embedding / STT / TTS model triggers on-demand load at `CreateAgent` (or voice-input / storage creation) time.
- **`LoadModelRequest` pins the model** for any of the four managed kinds. The server keeps it resident until `UnloadModelRequest`, regardless of agent count. Pinning is process-global.
- **`UnloadModelRequest` on a shared model is polite.** If any agent still uses the model, it stays resident; it is freed when the last user goes away.
- **VAD is not pin/unloadable.** Catalog `vad` entries are download / config metadata; offline STT loads them as a dependency. Sending `LoadModelRequest` for a VAD model returns `ModelResolutionFailed`.
- **Unused OnDemand models are swept before the next load.** When the server is about to load a new model into any of the four caches, it first frees idle OnDemand entries across all caches (pinned models and models still held by agents are left alone).
- **`DeleteModelRequest` removes the downloaded files from disk.** It reverses a download (back to `Absent`); it does not touch user-supplied `local_path` models.

See [How to pin and unpin models](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/pin-and-unpin-models.html) for the end-to-end walkthrough.

### `ModelInfo` fields

`ListModelsResponse` carries one `ModelInfo` per catalog entry, enriched with the metadata editors and clients need:

| Field               | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`              | Catalog name — the identifier used everywhere on the wire.                                                     |
| `status`            | Where the model is now (see [Model status](#model-status)).                                                    |
| `huggingface_repo`  | Download source slug, or empty if not downloadable.                                                            |
| `size_bytes`        | On-disk size when present.                                                                                     |
| `model_type`        | `"language"`                                                                                                   |
| `engine`            | `"llama-cpp"`                                                                                                  |
| `audience`          | `"public"`                                                                                                     |
| `tool_call_support` | Advisory tool-calling capability from the catalog: `"supported"`                                               |
| `context_size`      | Context window in tokens; `0` = engine default.                                                                |
| `files`             | Resolved variant filenames.                                                                                    |
| `local_path`        | On-disk directory, or empty when not on disk.                                                                  |
| `default_sampling`  | The catalog's recommended sampling params, if any.                                                             |
| `languages`         | Catalog-declared language codes; empty means undeclared, not "none".                                           |
| `dependencies`      | Shared assets the model needs: `id`, `role`, `status`, `size_bytes`, `folder`, `local_path`, `failure_reason`. |
| `tts_capabilities`  | TTS models only: the catalog's advertised controls, voice presets and inline tags.                             |

______________________________________________________________________

## Model status

The `ModelInfo.status` field in `ListModelsResponse` reports where a model is right now:

| Value         | Int | Meaning                                                                                  |
| ------------- | --- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Absent`      | 0   | Known in catalog but not on disk and not downloading.                                    |
| `Local`       | 1   | User-provided path resolved (`local_path`); on disk; can be loaded.                      |
| `Downloading` | 2   | Transfer in progress. `DownloadProgress` frames are flowing.                             |
| `Loaded`      | 3   | Currently resident in memory for its model kind (language, STT, TTS, or embedding).      |
| `Downloaded`  | 4   | On disk from a HuggingFace download; can be loaded.                                      |
| `Incomplete`  | 5   | Catalog parent is present but a shared-asset dependency is missing or still downloading. |

Ordinals match the `ModelStatus` enum on the [wire protocol](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/wire-protocol.html) and `ETryllModelStatus` in the Unreal client.

Loaded is per model kind

`Loaded` means the model is resident in the server's in-memory cache for **its specific kind**. A language model and an STT model are tracked independently — a voice-input session that pins an STT model will show it as `Loaded` whatever other models are loaded. `ListModels` reports every catalog model with its own engine and status, whatever engines the session hinted at.

______________________________________________________________________

## Retention modes

Tryll decides what to keep in memory based on a simple rule. The same two modes apply to **language, embedding, STT, and TTS** (each kind has its own cache; sweeps are cross-cache):

| Retention    | How it is triggered                                                                                                 | When the model is freed                                                                                   |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Pinned**   | `LoadModelRequest`                                                                                                  | On `UnloadModelRequest` (delayed until no agent uses it).                                                 |
| **OnDemand** | Implicit: an agent's graph (or voice input / TTS / embedding use) references the model, no prior `LoadModelRequest` | When the last user is destroyed **or** when the next validated model load sweeps unused OnDemand entries. |

Use **Pinned** for the hot model(s) on the machine — the latency cost of the first load is paid once at startup. Use **OnDemand** for secondary models where memory matters more than first-turn latency.

These labels match the client-facing names used in the glossary ([pinned retention](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#pinned-retention), [on-demand retention](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/glossary.html#ondemand-retention)).

See [Lifetime and Ownership → Models](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/concepts/lifetime-and-ownership.html#models) for the reference-counting story that connects Pinned / OnDemand to what nodes inside an agent actually hold.

______________________________________________________________________

## Editor window

Both plugins ship an editor-only **Model Manager** that drives the lifecycle above through a GUI — browse the catalog, download / load / unload / delete, and tag models for your build. Open it from **Window → Tryll → Model Manager** (Unity) or **Window → Tryll → Tryll Model Manager** (Unreal). The task walkthrough is [Manage Models in the Editor](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/manage-models-in-editor.html); this section is the reference for the two pieces of editor state it adds.

### Build registration

Each model can be tagged with a registration tier that decides whether it ships in a packaged build:

| Tier                    | Int | Meaning                                                 |
| ----------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `None` / Not registered | 0   | Not part of the build.                                  |
| `Experimental`          | 1   | Available in the editor; stripped from packaged builds. |
| `Production`            | 2   | Shipped in the packaged build.                          |

The registration is **project-side**, not server-side:

- **Unity:** a `TryllModelManifest` ScriptableObject at `Assets/Resources/TryllModelManifest.asset` (it must sit directly in a `Resources` folder so player builds can load it).
- **Unreal:** the `Tryll Model Manifest` developer settings, persisted to `DefaultGame.ini`.

### Registered-model pickers — `(tryll_model)`

Model-name fields on nodes and components render as a dropdown of registered models of the matching kind rather than a free-text box. This is driven by the `(tryll_model: "...")` schema attribute on the field; the editor resolves it against the manifest above:

| Field                                                                           | Kind       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `Generate` / `ToolCall` / `ClassifyIntentLLM` / `GenerateAndSpeak` `model_name` | `language` |
| Voice profile `tts_model_name`                                                  | `tts`      |
| Voice Input component STT model                                                 | `stt`      |

Unity emits a `[TryllModelType("...")]` drawer; Unreal swaps the field to `FTryllModelName` with `meta=(TryllModelType="...")`. A value that is set but unregistered still displays (never silently dropped), but only `Production`-tagged models ship in a build. The wire still carries the model name as a plain string — the picker is editor sugar.

______________________________________________________________________

## Download record — `downloads.json`

The server maintains a `downloads.json` file inside `models_root` — its download ledger — to track completed HuggingFace downloads. This file is **server-managed**; do not edit it by hand. Its contents feed `ModelInfo.status == Downloaded` at startup so that a previously downloaded model can be loaded without re-downloading. Shared model assets (for example the SNAC decoder) live in a sibling `assets` array with their own records. The server stores a per-file SHA-256 on each asset (`file_sha256`) when the download finishes. Listing compares that digest to the catalog pin; the file is re-hashed when a model actually loads the asset. Deleting a parent model does not delete a shared asset. A parent whose asset is still missing, the wrong size, or pinned to a different digest reports `Incomplete`. Release staging copies each reachable asset once.

Structure (for reference only):

```
{
    "entries": [
        {
            "name":        "Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M)",
            "engine":      "llama-cpp",
            "folder":      "bartowski--Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF",
            "files":       ["Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf"],
            "total_bytes": 2019377152
        }
    ]
}
```

`engine` is stored as the same engine name the catalog uses (`"llama-cpp"`, `"sherpa-onnx"`, `"onnx-runtime"`), not as the `InferenceEngine` ordinal the [wire protocol](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/wire-protocol.html) carries.

| [`6003`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/error-codes.html#6xxx-model-download) | Disk full in the download directory.                                                                                                               |

| [`6005`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/error-codes.html#6xxx-model-download) | `ModelResolutionFailed` — the model is not in the catalog, or it failed to load. Also returned by `LoadModel` for a VAD-only entry.                |
| [`6008`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/error-codes.html#6xxx-model-download) | `EngineNotAvailable` — the model's catalog engine is not included in this server build.                                                            |

# Voice Profile

A **voice profile** is an agent's voice: one TTS model, one base identity, a few speech settings, and a list of named **delivery modes** such as `angry` or `calm`. Each agent has at most one. Every speaking node of the agent ([Speak](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/speak.html) and [Generate and Speak](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/generate-and-speak.html)) speaks with it. The nodes themselves hold no voice settings, only their text routing and sentence chunking, so one workflow can drive many characters with different voices.

You pass the profile when you create the agent. Later you can replace it with `SetAgentVoice`, or switch its delivery mode with `SetAgentDeliveryMode`. `ChangeAgentParam` cannot reach any voice field.

Protocol v27

Before protocol v27 each speaking node carried its own `tts_model_name`, `speaker_id`, `speed`, `tts_lang`, `tts_voice`, `tts_voice_description`, `tts_delivery_instruction` and (on Generate and Speak) `emit_visemes`. Those node fields are gone. See [Moving from node voice fields](#moving-from-node-voice-fields) below, and the [release notes](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/release-notes/index.html) of the release that ships protocol v27 for the manual migration steps for Unity and Unreal projects.

## Fields

`VoiceProfile` (schema: `tryll/schema/voice.fbs`).

| Field                   | Type               | Default | Range                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ------------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tts_model_name`        | string             | —       | catalog TTS name                     | The TTS model. **Required**: there is no catalog default, and an empty name fails with `3023`.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `speaker_id`            | int                | `0`     | `0` to the model's speaker count − 1 | Built-in voice for multi-speaker models: Supertonic 3 style `0`–`9`, Orpheus preset `0`–`7`, Maya1 preset `0`–`1`. Single-speaker models (Pocket TTS, Chatterbox, Qwen3-TTS Base) accept only `0`.                                                                                                       |
| `reference_voice`       | string (file path) | empty   | —                                    | Reference clip for voice-cloning models (Pocket TTS, Chatterbox, Qwen3-TTS Base), relative to the storage root. Empty uses the model's default voice; Qwen3-TTS Base has none and requires a clip. Locale-aware: `voices/loc/<locale>/x.wav` beside `voices/x.wav` wins when the session locale matches. |
| `voice_description`     | string (multiline) | empty   | ≤ 1024 bytes                         | Maya1 only. Natural-language identity (age, accent, pitch, timbre). Replaces the `speaker_id` preset.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `speed`                 | float              | `1.0`   | `0.1`–`3.0`                          | Speech-rate multiplier. Must stay `1.0` on models without speed control (Orpheus, Maya1, Qwen3-TTS).                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `lang`                  | string             | empty   | —                                    | Synthesis language on models that pick it per call (Supertonic 3, Qwen3-TTS). Empty uses the session locale, then the catalog default. **Rejected** on fixed-language models (Pocket TTS, Orpheus, Maya1, Chatterbox).                                                                                   |
| `expressiveness`        | float              | `0.5`   | `0.0`–`2.0`                          | Chatterbox only: the exaggeration used by `neutral` and by modes that do not set their own. Ignored by other models.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `prepare`               | `VoicePreparation` | `Eager` | `Eager`, `Lazy`                      | When reference clips are prepared. See [Clip preparation](#clip-preparation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `emit_visemes`          | bool               | `false` | —                                    | Send a lip-sync viseme track for every sentence the agent speaks, from any speaking node. See [Add Lip Sync to a Character](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/add-lip-sync-to-a-character.html).                                                                                                  |
| `delivery_modes`        | `[DeliveryMode]`   | empty   | —                                    | Named deliveries. See [Delivery modes](#delivery-modes).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `default_delivery_mode` | string             | empty   | a defined mode name                  | Mode active after the voice is set. Empty means `neutral`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

`DeliveryMode`:

| Field             | Type                            | Default | Range             | Description                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`            | string                          | —       | `[a-z0-9_]{1,32}` | Required. Unique in the profile. `neutral` is reserved.                                                                                                                                  |
| `reference_voice` | string (file path)              | empty   | —                 | Clone models: a clip of this character speaking in this mood. Replaces the profile's `reference_voice` while the mode is active.                                                         |
| `instruction`     | string (multiline, localizable) | empty   | ≤ 1024 bytes      | Maya1: sustained delivery clause added to the voice description. A known keyword becomes a tuned clause (see [Maya1](#maya1-instructions-and-intensity)); other text is used as written. |
| `expressiveness`  | float                           | `-1`    | `0.0`–`2.0`       | Chatterbox: exaggeration for this mode. Negative means "use the profile's `expressiveness`".                                                                                             |
| `speed_scale`     | float                           | `1.0`   | `0.5`–`2.0`       | Multiplies the profile `speed` while the mode is active. Must stay `1.0` on models without speed control.                                                                                |

## Rules

The server checks the whole profile when the voice is set: at `CreateAgent` and at `SetAgentVoice`. A profile that fails is rejected; nothing is applied.

- **A speaking agent needs a voice.** If any node of the graph speaks and the request has no voice, `CreateAgent` fails with `3025 AgentVoiceRequired`. There is no default voice.
- **An agent that never speaks loads no TTS model.** You may still pass a voice. The server checks that its `tts_model_name` is in the catalog and validates the profile against that model's catalog capabilities. It does not load the model.
- **Unsupported fields are errors, not ignored.** A field the loaded model cannot use fails with `3023 InvalidVoiceProfile`, for example a `reference_voice` on Supertonic 3, a `voice_description` or `instruction` on anything but Maya1, a `speed` or `speed_scale` other than `1.0` on Orpheus, Maya1 or Qwen3-TTS, or a non-empty `lang` on a fixed-language model. The message names the field and, for a mode, the mode.
- **Text limits.** `voice_description` and `instruction` are at most 1024 bytes and must not contain `"`, `<`, `>` or control characters (tab, CR and LF are allowed).
- **Clip files must exist** when the voice is set, inside the storage root.
- **Session language.** When `lang` is empty and the session locale is a language the model does not declare, the voice fails with `3017 ModelLanguageUnsupported`. Set `lang`, or pick a model that covers the language. `SetSessionLocale` still feeds the voice's language each turn.

## Delivery modes

A delivery mode is a named way of speaking: `angry`, `calm`, `whisper`. Game code picks one with `SetAgentDeliveryMode(mode, intensity)`. The server turns that into whatever the loaded model understands, so game code does not need to know which model a character uses.

- **`neutral` is built in.** It is the base identity with no delivery applied. You cannot define it, and it is always accepted.
- **A mode may be empty.** A mode with no fields set sounds like `neutral`. Define the same mode names on every profile, and a call such as `SetAgentDeliveryMode("angry")` works on every character, including voices that have no way to express anger.
- **It applies from the next sentence.** The call is accepted at any time, even mid-turn. A sentence already handed to the TTS model is never changed.
- **Only the API sets it.** Nodes, the language model and inline tags cannot switch the mode.
- **An unknown name** fails with `3024 UnknownDeliveryMode`, and the current mode stays.
- **The mode survives a voice change** if the new profile defines a mode of the same name. Otherwise the new profile's `default_delivery_mode` applies, and the `Ack` carries a `warning`.

### Intensity

`intensity` is a number from `0` to `1` (clamped; default `1`). It scales the active mode where the model can use it:

- **Speed.** Effective speed = `speed` × lerp(1, `speed_scale`, intensity), clamped to `0.1`–`3.0`. At intensity `0` the mode's `speed_scale` has no effect.
- **Chatterbox.** Exaggeration goes from the profile's `expressiveness` (at `0`) to the mode's `expressiveness` (at `1`).
- **Maya1.** See [Maya1 instructions and intensity](#maya1-instructions-and-intensity).
- **A reference clip is all or nothing.** Intensity does not blend clips.

`neutral` ignores intensity.

### What a delivery mode can change, per model

Only three things in the current models carry a sustained mood: a reference clip (clone models), a natural-language clause (Maya1), and the Chatterbox exaggeration scalar. Supertonic 3 and Orpheus have no emotion control. On those two, a mode can only change speed, or must stay empty.

| Model                                 | Base identity                                           | A delivery mode can set                                                          | `intensity` does                             | Cost of switching mode                                               |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Supertonic 3                          | `speaker_id` (style `0`–`9`)                            | `speed_scale` only                                                               | scales `speed_scale`                         | none                                                                 |
| Pocket TTS                            | `reference_voice` (default `bria.wav`)                  | `reference_voice`, `speed_scale`                                                 | scales `speed_scale` only                    | first use of a clip computes an embedding, unless it was prepared    |
| Chatterbox EN / ML / Turbo (internal) | `reference_voice` (model default)                       | `reference_voice`, `expressiveness` (where the model supports it), `speed_scale` | lerps `expressiveness`; scales `speed_scale` | first use of a clip encodes it, unless it was prepared               |
| Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base                   | `reference_voice` (required)                            | `reference_voice` only                                                           | nothing                                      | first use of a clip runs the speaker encoder, unless it was prepared |
| Orpheus 3B FT                         | `speaker_id` (preset `0`–`7`)                           | nothing: modes must be empty                                                     | nothing                                      | none                                                                 |
| Maya1 3B                              | `voice_description`, else `speaker_id` (preset `0`–`1`) | `instruction`                                                                    | rewrites the clause's intensity word         | none                                                                 |

Clone models copy the mood of the clip along with the timbre, so a mode for Pocket TTS or Qwen3-TTS is "a recording of this character being angry". Record every mode clip with the same speaker; a clip from another speaker changes who is talking. See [Add Emotions to a Voice](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/add-emotions-to-a-voice.html) for the recipe, and [Clone a Voice](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/clone-a-voice.html) for the clip itself.

Changing the Orpheus preset changes who speaks, so it is not a delivery. Use `SetAgentVoice` for that.

`expressiveness` is accepted only by Chatterbox variants whose model has an exaggeration input; `ListModels` reports it as `TtsCapabilities.expressiveness`.

### Maya1 instructions and intensity

A mode's `instruction` is added to the voice description as a delivery clause. These keywords map to tuned clauses, matched as whole words (so `unhappy` does not match `happy`):

| Keyword                 | Clause                            |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `angry`, `anger`        | angry tone at high intensity      |
| `excited`               | energetic tone at high intensity  |
| `frightened`, `fearful` | frightened tone at high intensity |
| `happy`, `happily`      | happy tone at medium intensity    |
| `sad`, `sadly`          | sad tone at medium intensity      |
| `calm`                  | calm tone at low intensity        |
| `whisper`               | whispering, very quiet delivery   |
| `serious`               | serious, grave tone               |
| `sarcastic`             | sarcastic, dry tone               |
| `disappointed`          | disappointed, flat tone           |

Any other text is passed to the model as written.

Intensity rewrites the clause's `at <level> intensity` words, and only when `intensity` is below `1`: below `0.34` gives `low`, below `0.67` gives `medium`, anything else `high`. At `1` the clause stays as authored. A clause with no intensity words, such as `sarcastic, dry tone`, ignores intensity.

In our listen-back measurements, `excited` and `angry` raised Maya1's pitch clearly. `happy` and `sad` on flat text were within noise.

## Changing the voice at runtime

`SetAgentVoice` replaces the whole profile, including the model.

- **Idle only.** It is rejected with `3004 AgentBusy` while a turn runs, and also while the turn is paused.
- **All or nothing.** The server validates the new profile and prepares its clips before it swaps. If anything fails, the old voice stays.
- **Delivery mode.** Kept by name when the new profile defines it, otherwise the new `default_delivery_mode`, and the `Ack` carries a `warning`.
- **No voice yet.** An agent created without a voice cannot get one later: `SetAgentVoice` and `SetAgentDeliveryMode` fail with `3025`. Recreate the agent with a voice.

## Clip preparation

Clone models derive state from each clip (a speaker embedding or encoded audio) the first time they use it.

- **`Eager`** (default): the server prepares every clip in the profile, the base clip and every mode clip, when the voice is set. `CreateAgent` and `SetAgentVoice` take longer, and the first sentence in a new mode has no extra delay. Prepared clips stay cached while the agent's voice holds them.
- **`Lazy`**: each clip is prepared the first time it is spoken, so that sentence starts later. Use it for experiments.

Models without clips (Supertonic 3, Orpheus, Maya1) have nothing to prepare.

## Audio stream per turn

One agent turn has one audio stream, even when several speaking nodes run:

- `TtsAudioFormatFrame` is sent **once per turn**, by the first speaking node that produces audio. The sample rate cannot change inside a turn.
- Viseme offsets count from that format frame across every speaking node of the turn.
- `TtsAudioFrame.node_name` still names the node that produced each chunk.

## API

```
from tryll_client import DeliveryMode, VoiceProfile

mack = VoiceProfile(
    tts_model_name="Pocket TTS (int8)",
    reference_voice="voices/mack.wav",
    emit_visemes=True,
    delivery_modes=[
        DeliveryMode(name="angry", reference_voice="voices/mack_angry.wav"),
        DeliveryMode(name="calm",  reference_voice="voices/mack_calm.wav"),
    ])

agent = client.create_agent(graph, voice=mack)
agent.set_delivery_mode("angry", intensity=0.8)   # from the next sentence
agent.set_delivery_mode("neutral")
agent.set_voice(other_profile)                     # idle only
```

Errors raise `TryllError` with `code` `3023`, `3024`, `3025`, `3004` or `3017`. See the [Python client reference](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/python/index.html).

```
Tryll::VoiceProfileT mack;
mack.tts_model_name  = "Pocket TTS (int8)";
mack.reference_voice = "voices/mack.wav";
mack.emit_visemes    = true;

auto angry = std::make_unique<Tryll::DeliveryModeT>();
angry->name            = "angry";
angry->reference_voice = "voices/mack_angry.wav";
mack.delivery_modes.push_back(std::move(angry));

Tryll::Client::AgentCreateOptions opts;
opts.voice = std::move(mack);
auto agent = client.CreateAgent(graph, std::move(opts));

agent.SetDeliveryMode("angry", 0.8f);   // or SetDeliveryModeAsync
agent.SetVoice(otherProfile);           // or SetVoiceAsync; idle only
```

Errors throw `TryllError`. See the [C++ client reference](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/cpp/index.html).

Create a **Voice Profile** asset (**Create → Tryll → Voice Profile**) and assign it to the **Voice** field of the `TryllAgentComponent`. Set `TryllAgentComponent.Voice` from code before the agent is created for characters spawned at runtime. At runtime, call `SetVoiceAsync` and `SetDeliveryModeAsync` on the component or on `TryllAgent`. See the [Unity client reference](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html).

Create a **Tryll Voice Profile** data asset (`UTryllVoiceProfile`) and assign it to the **Voice Profile** property of the `UTryllAgentComponent`. At runtime, call **Set Voice** and **Set Delivery Mode**. See the [Unreal Blueprint catalog](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unreal/blueprint-catalog.html).

## Diagnostics

With `enable_diagnostics` on, each speaking node reports the voice it used: under `voice` on [Speak](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/speak.html#diagnostics) and under `tts` on [Generate and Speak](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/generate-and-speak.html#diagnostics).

| Key                                              | Meaning                                                                                                                                                             | Absent when        |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| `tts_model_name`                                 | The voice's TTS model.                                                                                                                                              | —                  |
| `speaker_id`, `speed`, `lang`, `reference_voice` | The profile values as authored. An empty `lang` means the session locale or catalog default applied; `reference_voice` is the authored path, not a per-locale file. | —                  |
| `voice_description`                              | The Maya1 identity.                                                                                                                                                 | Not set.           |
| `delivery_mode`                                  | The active mode (`neutral` when none).                                                                                                                              | —                  |
| `intensity`                                      | The active intensity.                                                                                                                                               | —                  |
| `delivery_instruction`                           | The active mode's `instruction`.                                                                                                                                    | The mode has none. |
| `emit_visemes`                                   | Whether the voice sends a viseme track.                                                                                                                             | —                  |
| `sample_rate`                                    | The model's native sample rate, in Hz.                                                                                                                              | —                  |

## Moving from node voice fields

Each old node field has one place in the profile. Chunking stays on the nodes.

| Old node field (protocol v26)                 | Voice profile (v27)                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tts_model_name`                              | `tts_model_name`, now required: an empty name no longer means "first catalog voice" |
| `speaker_id`                                  | `speaker_id`                                                                        |
| `speed`                                       | `speed`                                                                             |
| `tts_lang`                                    | `lang`                                                                              |
| `tts_voice`                                   | `reference_voice`                                                                   |
| `tts_voice_description`                       | `voice_description`                                                                 |
| `tts_delivery_instruction`                    | a delivery mode's `instruction`, selected with `SetAgentDeliveryMode`               |
| `emit_visemes` (Generate and Speak only)      | `emit_visemes`, now for every speaking node, including Speak                        |
| `min_sentence_chars`, `first_chunk_max_chars` | not moved: still on both nodes                                                      |

If two speaking nodes of one agent had different voice settings, pick one: an agent now has one voice. Calls that changed a voice field with `ChangeAgentParam` become `SetAgentVoice` (identity) or `SetAgentDeliveryMode` (mood).

## Errors

| Code   | Name                       | When                                                                               |
| ------ | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `3004` | `AgentBusy`                | `SetAgentVoice` while a turn runs or is paused.                                    |
| `3017` | `ModelLanguageUnsupported` | `lang` is empty and the model does not declare the session language.               |
| `3023` | `InvalidVoiceProfile`      | A profile field fails validation, or the model cannot use it.                      |
| `3024` | `UnknownDeliveryMode`      | `SetAgentDeliveryMode` names a mode the profile does not define.                   |
| `3025` | `AgentVoiceRequired`       | A speaking graph without a voice; or a voice call on an agent created without one. |

See [Error Codes](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/error-codes.html).
