# TryllAgentComponent

**Type:** `MonoBehaviour`\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllAgentComponent.cs`

Manages one [`TryllAgent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllagent) lifetime on a GameObject. Drop it on any GameObject to get an agent that connects, creates itself, and fires `UnityEvent`s as tokens arrive — no code required.

______________________________________________________________________

## Inspector fields

| Field                                     | Type                                                                                                         | Default           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `WorkflowAsset`                           | `TryllWorkflowAsset`                                                                                         | —                 | **Required.** Workflow graph asset to use. `CreateAgent` fails if this is unset. Author the graph as a [`TryllWorkflowAsset`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-workflow-asset.html) (**Create ▸ Tryll ▸ Workflow Asset**). To build a graph in code without a component, use [`TryllGraphBuilder`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllgraphbuilder) and [`TryllClient.RequestCreateAgentAsync`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-client.html). |
| `EnableDiagnostics`                       | `bool`                                                                                                       | `false`           | When true, the server includes LLM diagnostic info in `TurnComplete` payloads.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `MaintainDialogueHistory`                 | `bool`                                                                                                       | `true`            | When true (default) the agent keeps its full dialogue history across turns. Set false for a stateless agent whose history is discarded after each turn — for classification/routing agents that should not store or project prior turns.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `KvCacheInitialization`                   | `TryllKvCacheInitialization`                                                                                 | `AllocateOnly`    | Choose `AllocateOnly`, `Prefill`, or `DeferAllocation` for eligible language-model contexts at creation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `AutoCreateOnConnect`                     | `bool`                                                                                                       | `true`            | Automatically calls `CreateAgent()` when the session is ready (or when this component is enabled while already session-ready).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `Speaker`                                 | `TryllSpeaker`                                                                                               | —                 | Optional. Plays streaming TTS audio for this agent. When it is null and the graph speaks, `CreateAgent` uses the `TryllSpeaker` already on this GameObject, else adds one. Read at `CreateAgent`; a later change applies on the next `CreateAgent`. Leave null (and have no TTS nodes) to ignore TTS audio.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `Voice`                                   | [`TryllVoiceProfile`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-voice-profile.html) | —                 | The agent's voice: TTS model, speaker or reference clip, speed, language, visemes and delivery modes. **Required when the workflow has a `Speak` or `GenerateAndSpeak` node**: without it `CreateAgent` fails with `AgentVoiceRequired` (3025), and the Inspector shows the same error. Ignored (and no TTS model is loaded) when the workflow does not speak. Read at `CreateAgent`; set it from code before creation when spawning characters at runtime. Change a live agent's voice with `SetVoiceAsync`.                                                |
| `OverrideVoiceDelivery` / `VoiceDelivery` | `bool` / `string`                                                                                            | `false` / neutral | Per-agent override of the Voice profile's default delivery. The Inspector presents **Voice Delivery** as a checkbox and dropdown (neutral plus the assigned profile's modes). It is copied into `CreateAgent` without modifying the shared profile; changing it while an agent is live applies immediately.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `VariableOverrides`                       | `List<TryllVariableOverride>`                                                                                | empty             | Per-instance initial-value overrides for variables declared on the workflow (Material-Instance pattern). The custom Inspector shows one optional row per declared variable — checkbox, read-only name, typed value — rather than a free-form list. Stale serialized entries (renamed/removed declarations) appear in a warning foldout and are skipped at `CreateAgent` with a `Debug.LogWarning`.                                                                                                                                                           |

### Variable Overrides Inspector

For each variable declared on the `WorkflowAsset`, the Inspector draws:

1. **Override checkbox** — when checked, this component's value replaces the declaration's initial value at `CreateAgent` (and, in Play Mode, updates the live agent mirror — see below).
1. **Name** — read-only, taken from the declaration.
1. **Value** — the type-appropriate editor (int / float / string / bool / string-set). Disabled until the override is checked; enabling seeds the field from the workflow default.

Only enabled overrides are stored as active sparse entries. Disabling an override keeps the authored value on the component (so re-enabling restores it) but clears the override flag.

**Live agent (Play Mode or Tryll Chat):** editing an override row updates `Agent.Variables` immediately (local mirror) whenever `HasAgent` is true. The wire flush stays deferred — the update is sent before the next `SendMessage` / `Resume` / `ChangeParams`. Unchecking an override assigns the **workflow declaration default** (not `Reset()`, which would restore the CreateAgent-time merged initial). A **Flush Now** button under *Live Agent — Variables* calls `FlushIfDirty` for debugging (useful before the next chat turn).

## Public API

```
// Runtime state
public TryllAgent Agent   { get; }
public bool       HasAgent { get; }
public TryllSpeaker Speaker { get; set; }
public TryllVoiceProfile Voice { get; set; }
public bool OverrideVoiceDelivery { get; set; }
public string VoiceDelivery { get; set; }

// Actions
public async void CreateAgent();
public void       DestroyAgent();
public new void   SendMessage(string text);
public void       Cancel(TryllCancelMode mode = TryllCancelMode.StopAndKeep);
public void       ChangeParams(string nodeName, TryllNodeParamsBase @params,
                               Action<TryllError> onComplete = null);
public void       Resume(string resumeNode = "", Action<TryllError> onComplete = null);
public void       PrefillKvCache();
public void       EvictKvCache();
public void       GetKvCacheStatus();
public void       AppendInteractions(IReadOnlyList<TryllDialogInteraction> interactions);
public void       RemoveInteractionsFromEnd(int count);
public void       ExportDialog();
public void       ImportDialog(
    TryllDialogSnapshot snapshot,
    TryllDialogCompatibility compatibility = TryllDialogCompatibility.Strict);
public void       SaveDialog(string path, string saveId);
public void       LoadDialog(string path,
    TryllDialogCompatibility compatibility = TryllDialogCompatibility.Strict);
public void       RegisterTool(string toolName, Func<TryllToolCall, string> handler);
public void       RegisterTool(string toolName, Func<TryllToolCall, Task<string>> handler);
public TryllNodeParamsBase GetNodeParamsBaseline(string nodeName);

// Voice (protocol v27)
public Task<TryllError> SetVoiceAsync(TryllVoiceProfile profile);
public Task<TryllError> SetDeliveryModeAsync(string mode, float intensity = 1f);
```

Per-agent Variables are reached through the agent handle: `agentComponent.Agent.Variables` (a [`TryllAgentVariables`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllagentvariables) mirror). `Agent` is null until `OnAgentCreated` has fired.

`CreateAgent` is ignored when `HasAgent` is already true. On success it populates `Agent` and fires `OnAgentCreated`. On failure it fires `OnError` and logs to the console.

`SendMessage` fires `OnError` and logs a warning if no agent is ready.

`Cancel` cooperatively stops the in-flight turn (`OnTurnComplete` with `TryllTurnStatus.Cancelled`). No-op if no agent/turn is active.

`ChangeParams` / `Resume` complete via their result UnityEvents (`OnParamChanged` / `OnResumed`) and the optional per-call callback — exactly once per call. When no agent is ready they report `InvalidAgentId` (3001) through both channels immediately. `ChangeParams` is allowed while idle **or paused** (rejected with `AgentBusy` only while a turn is actively running between pauses).

`GetNodeParamsBaseline` returns a deep copy of the last authored params for the named node, or `null` if no agent is ready / the name is unknown. The returned object is already a clone — mutate it in place, then send via `ChangeParams`.

KV-cache operations are idle-only. Their result is aggregate status; sending after eviction restores eligible contexts automatically. This component exposes no status UI — use the result events below in your own UI if needed.

`AppendInteractions` / `RemoveInteractionsFromEnd` mutate scripted dialog history without running the graph. **Strict idle-only** — rejected with `AgentBusy` while a turn is running, paused, or during a KV-cache operation. See [Seed and edit dialog history](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/seed-and-edit-dialog-history.html).

`ExportDialog` captures the complete dialog into a `TryllDialogSnapshot`; `ImportDialog` replaces the complete dialog. Both are strict idle-only. The component reports completion through `OnDialogExported` / `OnDialogImported`. Tryll does not write a save file.

`SaveDialog` / `LoadDialog` persist the same snapshot to a path resolved against the server's process storage root and carry a caller `save_id` (the server stamps `saved_at_ms`). Completion is `OnDialogSaved` / `OnDialogLoaded`. See [Save and Load Agent State](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/save-and-load-agent-state.html).

`SetVoiceAsync` replaces the live agent's voice and, on success, makes the profile this component's `Voice`, so a re-created agent keeps it. It is admitted while the agent is idle or paused; a running turn rejects it with `AgentBusy` (3004), and a profile the model cannot use with `InvalidVoiceProfile` (3023), keeping the old voice. With no agent yet it only stores the profile for the next `CreateAgent` and returns Ok; while a create is in flight it returns `AgentBusy`.

`SetDeliveryModeAsync` switches the delivery mode (a mode name from the voice profile, or the built-in `"neutral"`). It is accepted at any time, including mid-turn, and applies from the next sentence. `intensity` (0–1) scales the mode where the model can use it. Errors: `UnknownDeliveryMode` (3024), `AgentVoiceRequired` (3025) when the agent has no voice, `InvalidAgentId` when no agent is ready.

`RegisterTool` has a synchronous and an async (`Task<string>`) overload. A complete paused batch auto-resumes only after every handler finishes on the main thread.

______________________________________________________________________

## Events

The `UnityEvent` rows wire up in the Inspector or with `AddListener`. The NodeEvent rows (`ToolCallNotification` through `NodeEvent`) are C# `event`s: subscribe in code. They have no agent id — this component is the agent. `TryllClient` keeps the all-agents versions. `TryllAgent` exposes the same seven events for an agent you created without a component. A typed subscriber on this component suppresses this component's `NodeEvent` for that event, and does not suppress `TryllClient.NodeEvent`.

| Event                        | Signature                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OnAnswerText`               | `(string nodeName, string text, bool isDelta, bool isFinal)`                | Fired for each token chunk. `nodeName` attributes the producing workflow node; `isDelta=true` when the chunk is a streaming delta; `isFinal=true` on the last chunk of the turn.          |
| `OnTurnComplete`             | `(TryllTurnStatus status, string debugInfo, int tokensGenerated)`           | Fired once per turn after the last `OnAnswerText`. `debugInfo` is non-empty only when `EnableDiagnostics` is true.                                                                        |
| `OnError`                    | `(TryllError error)`                                                        | Fired on any agent-level error.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `OnAgentCreated`             | `UnityEvent`                                                                | Fired when `CreateAgent()` completes successfully.                                                                                                                                        |
| `OnAgentDestroyed`           | `UnityEvent`                                                                | Fired when the agent is destroyed (by this component, by the server, or on disconnect).                                                                                                   |
| `OnParamChanged`             | `(TryllError error)`                                                        | Fired when a `ChangeParams` request completes. Check `error.IsOk` — `TryllError` is a value type (success is not null).                                                                   |
| `OnResumed`                  | `(TryllError error)`                                                        | Fired when a `Resume` request completes. Check `error.IsOk`. Failures include `AgentNotPaused` (3012) and `UnknownNode` (3005).                                                           |
| `OnKvCachePrefilled`         | `(TryllKvCachePrefillResult result, TryllError error)`                      | Fired after a prefill request. `TryllKvCachePrefillResult` extends `TryllKvCacheStatus` with `ContextsCreated`, `TokensDecoded`, and `TokensReused`. Listeners must take this exact type. |
| `OnKvCacheEvicted`           | `(TryllKvCacheEvictResult result, TryllError error)`                        | Fired after an eviction request. `TryllKvCacheEvictResult` extends `TryllKvCacheStatus` with `ContextsEvicted`. Listeners must take this exact type.                                      |
| `OnKvCacheStatus`            | `(TryllKvCacheStatus result, TryllError error)`                             | Fired after an aggregate status request.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `OnInteractionsAppended`     | `(uint count, TryllError error)`                                            | Fired when `AppendInteractions` completes. `count` is `appended_count` from the server.                                                                                                   |
| `OnInteractionsRemoved`      | `(uint count, TryllError error)`                                            | Fired when `RemoveInteractionsFromEnd` completes. `count` is `removed_count`.                                                                                                             |
| `OnDialogExported`           | `(TryllDialogSnapshot snapshot, TryllError error)`                          | Fired when `ExportDialog` completes. Encode a successful snapshot with `ToFlatBufferBytes`.                                                                                               |
| `OnDialogImported`           | `(TryllDialogImportResult result, TryllError error)`                        | Fired when `ImportDialog` completes. The result contains the restored interaction count and any compatibility warnings.                                                                   |
| `OnDialogSaved`              | `(TryllDialogFileSaveResult result, TryllError error)`                      | Fired when `SaveDialog` completes.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `OnDialogLoaded`             | `(TryllDialogFileLoadResult result, TryllError error)`                      | Fired when `LoadDialog` completes.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `ToolCallNotification`       | `event Action<string, string>`                                              | `(toolName, argumentsJson)` for this agent.                                                                                                                                               |
| `ToolCallNotificationWithId` | `event Action<string, string, string>`                                      | `(callId, toolName, argumentsJson)`. Use the id when resuming with a result.                                                                                                              |
| `ToolCallDetailed`           | `event Action<TryllToolCall>`                                               | Node name and disposition included. A subscriber suppresses `NodeEvent` for that call.                                                                                                    |
| `IntentClassified`           | `event Action<TryllIntentClassification>`                                   | Embedding ClassifyIntent result. The payload has no agent id.                                                                                                                             |
| `IntentLlmClassified`        | `event Action<TryllIntentLlmClassification>`                                | ClassifyIntentLLM result. The payload has no agent id.                                                                                                                                    |
| `Paused`                     | `event Action<string, string>`                                              | `(nodeName, pendingExit)`. This agent's turn paused.                                                                                                                                      |
| `NodeEvent`                  | `event Action<string, string, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, string>>>` | `(nodeName, eventType, kvPairs)`. Generic fallback when no typed listener is bound here.                                                                                                  |

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifetime and ownership

- The component **owns** its agent. It calls `Agent.Dispose()` in `OnDisable` and `OnDestroy`.
- Do **not** retain the `Agent` reference beyond the component's lifetime.
- If you need an agent that outlives the component, create it directly via [`TryllClient.RequestCreateAgentAsync`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-client.html) and manage its lifetime yourself.
- On disconnect the component clears its local state without sending a `DestroyAgent` wire message (the TCP connection is gone).

# TryllWorkflowAsset

**Type:** `ScriptableObject`\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllWorkflowAsset.cs`

`ScriptableObject` that stores a `TryllGraphDescription` as a project asset. Assign it to a [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html) to define which workflow graph the agent runs. Because it is a regular Unity asset, it is serialized, version-controlled, and reusable across multiple GameObjects.

______________________________________________________________________

## Creating an asset

In the Project window: **right-click → Create → Tryll → Workflow Asset**.

The asset opens in the Inspector where you can configure `Graph` nodes and their exit fields, or populate them programmatically via [`TryllGraphBuilder`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllgraphbuilder).

______________________________________________________________________

## Public API

```
public sealed class TryllWorkflowAsset : ScriptableObject
{
    public TryllGraphDescription Graph;
    public List<TryllVariableDecl> Variables;
}
```

`Graph` is the complete workflow graph description. It is serialized by Unity's standard serialization and editable in the Inspector.

`Variables` declares the agent's [Agent Variables](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/concepts/agent-variables.html) store — name, type, and initial value, passed to `CreateAgent`. A `TryllAgentComponent.VariableOverrides` entry may override a declared variable's initial value per-instance without changing this asset (Material-Instance pattern).

______________________________________________________________________

## Programmatic alternative

If you do not need a persistent asset, build a `TryllGraphDescription` in C# and create the agent directly from it — no component required:

```
var graph = new TryllGraphBuilder()
    .AddGenerate("gen", new TryllGenerateParams
    {
        // DefaultExit is "" (END) by default
    })
    .SetStartNode("gen")
    .SetDefaultModelName("my-model")
    .Build();

var (agent, error) = await TryllClient.Instance.RequestCreateAgentAsync(graph);
```

When you drive an agent through [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html), assign this asset to the component's **Workflow Asset** field. A component cannot create an agent without one.

______________________________________________________________________

- [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html) — uses this asset at agent creation
- [`TryllGraphBuilder`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllgraphbuilder) — fluent builder for `TryllGraphDescription`
- [Build a chat agent with a graph](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/build-chat-agent-with-graph.html)

# TryllRuntimeSettings

**Type:** `ScriptableObject`\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllRuntimeSettings.cs`

Project-level settings for the Tryll Client package. Persisted to `Assets/Resources/TryllRuntimeSettings.asset` (created automatically on first access).

Edit via **Project Settings → Tryll Client** (registered by `TryllRuntimeSettingsProvider`).

______________________________________________________________________

## Loading at runtime

```
var settings = TryllRuntimeSettings.Load();
```

`Load()` returns a cached singleton. If the asset does not exist in `Resources`, it falls back to default values.

______________________________________________________________________

## Fields

### Server process

| Field                | Type                   | Default   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------- | ---------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `AutoLaunchServer`   | `bool`                 | `true`    | When true, `TryllClient` spawns the bundled `tryll_server.exe` automatically on startup (Windows only). Set to `false` when you manage the server yourself.                                                                                                  |
| `LlamaCppBackend`    | `TryllLlamaCppBackend` | `Vulkan`  | llama.cpp GPU plugin for an auto-launched server (`Vulkan` or `Auto`). Passed as `--llama-backend`. `Auto` prefers CUDA on NVIDIA when those DLLs were staged and a player build copies them; `Vulkan` skips them. Ignored when `AutoLaunchServer` is false. |
| `ServerBuildVariant` | `ServerBuild`          | `Default` | Which bundled server payload to launch/stage: `Default` or `Release`.                                                                                                                                                                                        |

The server exe is always resolved from the package payload — bundled in the package in the Editor, or the `Server/` folder copied next to the player exe at build time — so there is **no path to configure**.

### Connection defaults

| Field        | Type     | Default       | Description                                  |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `ServerHost` | `string` | `"127.0.0.1"` | Host name or IP address of the Tryll server. |
| `ServerPort` | `int`    | `9100`        | TCP port the Tryll server listens on.        |

### Session engines

There are no engine dropdowns. Each model's engine comes from its catalog entry. `BuildEngineDeclarations()` derives an optional warm-up hint from the models registered in the Model Manager, and `CreateSession` sends it so the server starts those engines early. The hint never gates a load. See [Choose where models run](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/choose-where-models-run.html).

### Storage

| Field               | Type     | Default          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `StorageDataFolder` | `string` | `"TryllStorage"` | Project-relative root **outside** `Assets/`. The editor launches the server with `--storage-root` pointing here. Default `<Project>/TryllStorage/`. A path under `Assets/` is rejected. Protocol v24 no longer sends this on `CreateSession`. |

### Editor / Play Mode

| Field                      | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------- | ------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `EnablePlayModeModelGuard` | `bool` | `true`  | When true, entering Play Mode (or the Chat window) verifies every registered model is downloaded first, blocking behind a cancelable dialog if not. |

### Telemetry

| Field      | Type     | Default | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GameName` | `string` | `""`    | Integration identifier sent on every session for telemetry grouping. Use a short, stable, lowercase slug (e.g. `"my-game"`). Leave empty to omit. |

# TryllSpeaker

**Type:** `MonoBehaviour` (sealed)\
**Menu:** Add Component → Tryll → Tryll Speaker\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllSpeaker.cs`

Plays streaming TTS audio from a [`TryllAgent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/index.html#tryllagent) through an `AudioSource`. Wire it up by assigning this component to the `Speaker` slot on a [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html), let `TryllAgentComponent` find or add it when the graph contains a `GenerateAndSpeak` / `Speak` node (it uses a `TryllSpeaker` already on the GameObject, else adds one, at `CreateAgent`), or attach it to a code-created agent:

```
var speaker = GetComponent<TryllSpeaker>(); // or AddComponent
agent.SetOnTtsAudioFormat(speaker.HandleFormat);
agent.SetOnTtsAudio(speaker.HandleAudio);
```

______________________________________________________________________

## Requirements

`[RequireComponent(typeof(AudioSource))]` — Unity provisions an `AudioSource` automatically when `TryllSpeaker` is added to a GameObject.

______________________________________________________________________

## Inspector fields

| Field  | Type          | Default | Description                                                                                                                                            |
| ------ | ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `_src` | `AudioSource` | auto    | The `AudioSource` used for playback. Populated automatically in `Awake`; override only when using a pre-existing `AudioSource` on the same GameObject. |

______________________________________________________________________

## Runtime state

| Member            | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `HasPendingAudio` | `bool` | True while decoded audio is still waiting in the chunk queue (or the front chunk is only partially played). After the turn's `TurnComplete` — when no further audio arrives — a `false` value means playback has drained down to the small (~100 ms) streaming clip buffer. Useful for hands-free flows that must not re-open the microphone while the character is still audibly speaking. Main thread. |
| `ConsumedSamples` | `long` | Playback clock: samples handed to the audio device since the stream started, at the current sample rate. Underrun silence is not counted; audio dropped unplayed (cancel, format change, disable) counts as played, so the clock never falls behind the stream. Restarts at 0 when the sample rate changes. Any thread.                                                                                  |
| `QueuedSamples`   | `long` | Samples still waiting in the queue, including the unplayed tail of the front chunk. `ConsumedSamples + QueuedSamples` at a format announcement is where that turn's audio starts. Main thread.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `StopPlayback()`  | `void` | Cancels the current playback: drops all queued audio and ignores further audio frames until the next format announcement, which arrives once per agent turn — so the rest of the turn stays silent, across every speaking node. Does not cancel the turn; call `Cancel` on the agent for that. Safe to call repeatedly and when nothing is playing. Main thread.                                         |

`AudioSource.isPlaying` is not a playback signal here: the streaming clip loops and keeps "playing" silence between turns.

______________________________________________________________________

## Events

Both fire on the Unity main thread and are additive multicast (`+=`). `TryllLipSync` uses them; subscribe yourself to drive your own track.

| Event         | Signature                                                                  | When                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OnTtsFormat` | `Action<string nodeName, int sampleRate, int channels, int bitsPerSample>` | Each format announcement (one per agent turn, from its first speaking node), after the mono-int16 check and after a sample-rate change has reset the clock. |
| `OnTtsPcm`    | `Action<string nodeName, ArraySegment<short> pcm>`                         | Each PCM chunk, before the format and `StopPlayback` checks. The segment is valid only during the callback.                                                 |

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifecycle and threading

| Method                                                        | Thread       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `HandleFormat(nodeName, sampleRate, channels, bitsPerSample)` | Main thread  | Public. Called when the server announces the audio format (via `TryllAgent.SetOnTtsAudioFormat` or `TryllAgentComponent`). Creates the streaming `AudioClip` on the first call and reuses it while the sample rate stays the same; a new rate rebuilds it, discards queued audio and restarts `ConsumedSamples` at 0. Lifts `StopPlayback` and raises `OnTtsFormat`. Outside Play mode (for example the Tryll Chat window) it logs an error and plays nothing. `nodeName` is accepted for signature compatibility and unused — this speaker mixes all producers into one `AudioSource`. Only mono int16 PCM is supported; other formats are logged as warnings and ignored. |
| `HandleAudio(nodeName, ArraySegment<short>)`                  | Main thread  | Public. Raises `OnTtsPcm`, then converts int16 → float32 and enqueues the chunk. Ignored before the first format, and after `StopPlayback` until the next format. `nodeName` is unused (same as `HandleFormat`). Drops the newest chunk with a logged warning when the queue is full (`kMaxQueuedChunks = 1024`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `PcmReader(float[])`                                          | Audio thread | Drains the chunk queue into Unity's audio buffer. Zero-fills the tail on underrun.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

`HandleFormat` and `HandleAudio` fire on the Unity main thread (drained by `TryllClient.Update`). `PcmReader` runs on the Unity audio thread. The two share a chunk queue protected by a brief lock.

______________________________________________________________________

## End-of-stream

`TtsAudioFrame` carries no `is_final` flag — the turn ends with `TurnComplete`. The queue drains naturally; there is no explicit flush. When the `AudioSource` reaches the tail of the queue it will play silence until the next turn starts a new stream.

______________________________________________________________________

## Overflow behaviour

TTS synthesis runs well above realtime for typical responses. When many chunks arrive faster than they are played the queue fills. On overflow the **newest** incoming chunk is dropped (not the oldest), producing a minor glitch rather than a truncated sentence. A single warning is logged per turn's stream (the counter resets at each format announcement).

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifetime and ownership

- `TryllSpeaker` does not own its `TryllAgent`. `TryllAgentComponent` owns both when you use the component path; a code-created agent owns the wiring via `SetOnTtsAudioFormat` / `SetOnTtsAudio`.
- `OnDisable` stops playback and clears the chunk queue.
- `OnDestroy` destroys the `AudioClip`.
- Safe to disable between turns (playback stops immediately, queue clears). Re-enabling before the next `HandleFormat` call is fine.

______________________________________________________________________

## See also

- [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html) — manages the agent and routes TTS callbacks to this component
- [How-to: Add Voice Output to an Agent](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/add-voice-to-an-agent.html)
- [Concept: TTS and Voice Output](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/concepts/tts-and-voice-output.html)
- [Reference: GenerateAndSpeak node](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/nodes/generate-and-speak.html)

# TryllLipSync

**Type:** `MonoBehaviour` (sealed)\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllLipSync.cs`\
**Menu:** Add Component → Tryll → Tryll Lip Sync

Plays an agent's viseme track on a face with ARKit blendshapes, in step with the audio played by a [`TryllSpeaker`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-speaker.html). The agent's [voice profile](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-voice-profile.html) must have **Emit Visemes** on — see [Add Lip Sync to a Character](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/how-to/add-lip-sync-to-a-character.html).

______________________________________________________________________

## Requirements

- `[RequireComponent(typeof(TryllSpeaker))]` — the speaker on the same GameObject is the playback clock. Assign it to the [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html)'s **Speaker** field so the agent's audio plays through it.
- A [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html) — the source of the viseme track. A warning is logged in `Awake` if none is assigned or found on the GameObject.
- A [`TryllVoiceProfile`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-voice-profile.html) on that component with **Emit Visemes** on. Without it no viseme track arrives: the Inspector shows a warning, and one is logged when the agent is bound.
- Face meshes whose blendshapes use ARKit names.

______________________________________________________________________

## Inspector fields

### Source

| Field      | Type                  | Default         | Description                                                                              |
| ---------- | --------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_agent`   | `TryllAgentComponent` | same GameObject | Agent whose viseme track is played. Re-binds automatically when the agent is re-created. |
| `_speaker` | `TryllSpeaker`        | same GameObject | Speaker whose playback position the face follows.                                        |

### Face

| Field        | Type                        | Default | Description                                                                                                       |
| ------------ | --------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_renderers` | `List<SkinnedMeshRenderer>` | empty   | Meshes to drive. Bound at `Start` when set.                                                                       |
| `_faceRoot`  | `Transform`                 | none    | Parent of the face meshes. When **Renderers** is empty, every `SkinnedMeshRenderer` under it is bound at `Start`. |

Set one of the two, or call `BindFace` at runtime; with neither, no mesh is driven.

Only blendshapes named by the **Map** are bound and written; every other blendshape on those meshes is left untouched for other animation to drive. `MappedShapes` counts the bound ones.

### Clock

| Field                      | Type    | Default | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_smoothPlaybackClock`     | `bool`  | `true`  | Smooths the speaker's playback position into a steady clock.                                                                    |
| `_clockWindowSeconds`      | `float` | `1.5`   | Window of the clock smoother.                                                                                                   |
| `_outputLeadTrimMs`        | `float` | `342`   | How far the streaming clip's buffer runs ahead of what is audible. Device-dependent; adjust when a large sync offset is needed. |
| `_compensateOutputLatency` | `bool`  | `true`  | Subtracts Unity's DSP buffer latency.                                                                                           |
| `_syncOffsetMs`            | `float` | `0`     | Manual sync correction. Positive moves the face earlier.                                                                        |

### Envelope

| Field                        | Type            | Default | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | --------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_attackDecayMs`             | `float`         | `50`    | Cross-fade between consecutive shapes.                                                                                                 |
| `_intensity`                 | `float` (0–1.5) | `0.4`   | Scale on every pose. `0` = no movement, `1` = the full pose table.                                                                     |
| `_smoothingPerSecond`        | `float` (0–120) | `16`    | Rate at which the face moves toward each shape. `0` disables smoothing.                                                                |
| `_closureSmoothingPerSecond` | `float` (0–200) | `60`    | Rate used while a lip closure (`PP`, `FF`) is active.                                                                                  |
| `_maxHoldMs`                 | `float`         | `400`   | Returns to rest when the last shape of a turn has been held this long (cancelled turns). `0` disables.                                 |
| `_compensateSmoothingLag`    | `bool`          | `true`  | Samples the track ahead by the delay the smoothing adds (`1000 / smoothing + attack / 2` ms), so tuning smoothing does not shift sync. |

### Mapping

| Field  | Type                    | Default        | Description                                                                                             |
| ------ | ----------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_map` | `List<TryllVisemePose>` | built-in table | Pose per viseme, as ARKit channel weights. Left empty, it is filled with the built-in table at `Awake`. |

### Diagnostics and apply

| Field              | Type   | Default | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `_logFrameArrival` | `bool` | `false` | Logs how far ahead of playback each viseme frame arrived.      |
| `_applyToMesh`     | `bool` | `true`  | When off, the pose is evaluated but not written to the meshes. |

______________________________________________________________________

| `SmoothingLagMs`                          | `float`                        | Look-ahead currently applied for the smoothing delay.                                                                                                                                             |

| `VisemeSetupProblem(TryllAgentComponent)` | `static string`                | Why the agent will send no viseme track (no voice profile, or Emit Visemes off), or `null` when it is set up.                                                                                     |

______________________________________________________________________

## Built-in pose table

The 15 visemes and the ARKit channels each one drives (before **Intensity** and the event weight are applied):

| Viseme | Sounds (as in)                                  | Channels                                                                      |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sil`  | rest, pauses                                    | —                                                                             |
| `PP`   | **p**en, **b**at, **m**e                        | `mouthClose` .55, `mouthPressLeft`/`Right` .45, `mouthPucker` .15             |
| `FF`   | **f**an, **v**an                                | `jawOpen` .12, `mouthLowerDownLeft`/`Right` .55, `mouthFunnel` .15            |
| `TH`   | **th**in, **th**at                              | `jawOpen` .18, `mouthStretchLeft`/`Right` .25, `mouthUpperUpLeft`/`Right` .20 |
| `DD`   | **t**op, **d**og                                | `jawOpen` .22, `mouthClose` .15                                               |
| `kk`   | **k**ey, **g**o                                 | `jawOpen` .32                                                                 |
| `CH`   | **ch**in, **j**am, **sh**e, mea**s**ure         | `jawOpen` .18, `mouthFunnel` .45, `mouthPucker` .20                           |
| `SS`   | **s**un, **z**oo                                | `jawOpen` .08, `mouthStretchLeft`/`Right` .55                                 |
| `nn`   | **n**o, **l**ow, si**ng**                       | `jawOpen` .14, `mouthClose` .20                                               |
| `RR`   | **r**ed                                         | `jawOpen` .16, `mouthPucker` .35, `mouthFunnel` .15                           |
| `aa`   | f**a**ther, c**a**t, c**u**p, **a**bout, m**y** | `jawOpen` .72                                                                 |
| `E`    | b**e**d, s**ay**, h**er**                       | `jawOpen` .38, `mouthStretchLeft`/`Right` .45                                 |
| `ih`   | s**i**t, s**ee**, **y**es                       | `jawOpen` .28, `mouthStretchLeft`/`Right` .28                                 |
| `oh`   | l**aw**, g**o**, b**oy**                        | `jawOpen` .48, `mouthFunnel` .55, `mouthPucker` .25                           |
| `ou`   | y**ou**, b**oo**k, h**ow**, **w**e              | `jawOpen` .28, `mouthPucker` .72, `mouthFunnel` .35                           |

## Related types

| Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `TryllVisemeEvent`         | `readonly struct`: `SampleOffset` (`uint`, samples from the start of the turn's audio — its format announcement — across every speaking node of the turn), `Viseme` (`WireViseme`), `Weight` (`float`, 0–1). |
| `TryllAgent.OnTtsVisemes`  | `event Action<string, TryllVisemeEvent[]>` — fired on the main thread for each viseme frame (one per synthesized sentence). The array belongs to the invocation; copy it to keep it.                         |
| `WireViseme`               | `enum : byte` in namespace **`Tryll`** (add `using Tryll;`): `sil, PP, FF, TH, DD, kk, CH, SS, nn, RR, aa, E, ih, oh, ou`.                                                                                   |
| `TryllVisemePose`          | Serializable: `Viseme` + `Channels` (`TryllVisemeChannelWeight[]`).                                                                                                                                          |
| `TryllVisemeChannelWeight` | Serializable: `Channel` (ARKit blendshape name) + `Weight`.                                                                                                                                                  |

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifecycle and threading

- `Awake` fills the default map and builds the pose table; `Start` binds the meshes; `OnEnable` subscribes to the agent's viseme events.
- Each `LateUpdate` evaluates the pose at the current playback position and writes it to the meshes. Everything runs on the main thread.
- Each audio format announcement (one per agent turn) clears the previous track.
- `OnDisable` unsubscribes and resets the clock and smoothing.

# TryllVoiceProfile

**Type:** `ScriptableObject` (sealed)\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllVoiceProfile.cs`, `Runtime/TryllVoiceProfileData.cs`\
**Menu:** Create → Tryll → Voice Profile

A character's voice as an asset: which TTS model speaks, the base identity (speaker, reference clip or description), speed and language, whether a viseme track is emitted, and named **delivery modes** (moods such as `angry` or `calm`) that game code switches at runtime.

Assign the profile to a [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html)'s **Voice** field. Every speaking node of that agent (`Speak`, `GenerateAndSpeak`) uses it; the nodes hold no voice settings. Because the voice lives on the agent and not in the workflow, one workflow asset can drive many characters, each with its own profile.

A workflow with a speaking node cannot create an agent without a voice: the server rejects it with `AgentVoiceRequired` (3025). There is no default voice and no default model. A workflow that does not speak ignores the profile and loads no TTS model.

______________________________________________________________________

## Fields

The asset holds one `TryllVoiceProfileData` in its `Data` field.

| Field                 | Type                      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------- | ------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `TtsModelName`        | `string`                  | —       | **Required.** TTS model catalog name, picked from the registered TTS models.                                                                                                                             |
| `SpeakerId`           | `int`                     | `0`     | Speaker / style index for multi-speaker models (Supertonic 3: 0–9; Orpheus, Maya1: preset index). Must be below the model's speaker count.                                                               |
| `ReferenceVoice`      | `string`                  | empty   | Reference clip (`.wav`) for clone models (Pocket TTS, Chatterbox, Qwen3-TTS Base), relative to the storage root. Locale-aware: `voices/loc/<locale>/` is tried first. Empty = the model's default voice. |
| `VoiceDescription`    | `string`                  | empty   | Maya1: natural-language identity of the voice. Overrides `SpeakerId`.                                                                                                                                    |
| `Speed`               | `float`                   | `1.0`   | Speech-rate multiplier, 0.1–3.0. Must stay 1.0 on models without speed control.                                                                                                                          |
| `Lang`                | `string`                  | empty   | Language for multilingual models that pick it per call. Empty = session locale, then the model default. Rejected on models with a fixed language.                                                        |
| `Expressiveness`      | `float`                   | `0.5`   | Chatterbox exaggeration, 0.0–2.0, used by `neutral` and by modes that do not set their own. Ignored by other models.                                                                                     |
| `Prepare`             | `TryllVoicePreparation`   | `Eager` | When reference clips are prepared: `Eager` (all clips when the voice is set, so the first sentence in a new mode has no extra latency) or `Lazy` (on first use).                                         |
| `EmitVisemes`         | `bool`                    | `false` | Emit a viseme track for every sentence the agent speaks. Turn on for characters with [`TryllLipSync`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-lip-sync.html).                 |
| `DeliveryModes`       | `List<TryllDeliveryMode>` | empty   | Named deliveries (below).                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `DefaultDeliveryMode` | `string`                  | empty   | Mode active after the voice is set. Empty = `neutral`.                                                                                                                                                   |

### TryllDeliveryMode

| Field            | Type     | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ---------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Name`           | `string` | —       | Mode name: 1–32 characters of `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, unique in the profile. `neutral` is built in and cannot be defined.                                                                                       |
| `ReferenceVoice` | `string` | empty   | Clone models: a clip of this character in this mood. Replaces the profile clip while the mode is active.                                                                                                   |
| `Instruction`    | `string` | empty   | Maya1: sustained delivery clause. A known keyword (`angry`, `sad`, `whisper`, …) becomes its tuned clause. A ticked Text ID in this field is not resolved; the text resolver only walks graph node params. |
| `Expressiveness` | `float`  | `-1`    | Chatterbox exaggeration for this mode, 0.0–2.0. Negative = the profile value.                                                                                                                              |
| `SpeedScale`     | `float`  | `1.0`   | Multiplies the profile speed while the mode is active, 0.5–2.0. Must stay 1.0 on models without speed control.                                                                                             |

A mode with no fields set behaves like `neutral`. This lets every profile define the same mode names, so game code that asks for `angry` works on any voice, including models with no emotion channel.

A field the model cannot use (a reference clip on Supertonic, an instruction on Qwen3-TTS) is an error: the server rejects the profile with `InvalidVoiceProfile` (3023) when the voice is set.

______________________________________________________________________

## Inspector

The custom Inspector shows only what the chosen model can use, read from the catalog's TTS capabilities:

- **Speaker** is a preset dropdown for models with named presets (Orpheus, Maya1), a slider for multi-speaker models (Supertonic 3), and hidden for single-speaker models.
- **Reference Voice**, **Voice Description**, **Speed**, **Lang** and **Expressiveness** appear only for models that support them. A field that holds a value the model cannot use stays visible so you can clear it.
- **Delivery Modes** is a reorderable list whose rows apply the same rules.
- **Default Delivery Mode** is a dropdown of the defined modes.
- Validation findings (missing model, bad mode names, unsupported fields, missing clip files) are shown at the bottom.

When the catalog cannot be read, every field is shown.

**Assets ▸ Tryll ▸ Validate Workflow** also validates selected voice profiles. A Windows Standalone build fails when a profile names a model that is not marked Production in the Model Manager.

______________________________________________________________________

## Using a profile from code

```
// Spawning a character: set the voice before the agent is created.
var agent = go.AddComponent<TryllAgentComponent>();
agent.AutoCreateOnConnect = false;
agent.WorkflowAsset = merchantWorkflow;
agent.Voice = merchantVoice;          // TryllVoiceProfile asset
agent.CreateAgent();

// Mood: any time, including mid-turn; applies from the next sentence.
var err = await agent.SetDeliveryModeAsync("angry", intensity: 0.8f);

// Identity: idle (or paused) only.
err = await agent.SetVoiceAsync(disguisedVoice);
```

Without a component, build a `TryllVoiceProfileData` and pass it to [`TryllClient.RequestCreateAgentAsync`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-client.html) (`voice:`), then use `TryllAgent.SetVoiceAsync` / `SetDeliveryModeAsync`.

```
public sealed class TryllVoiceProfileData
{
    public const string NeutralMode = "neutral";
    public TryllVoiceProfileData Clone();
    public Tryll.VoiceProfileT ToWire();
    public static TryllVoiceProfileData FromWire(Tryll.VoiceProfileT wire);
    public static bool IsValidModeName(string name);
}
```

| Error                        | When                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidVoiceProfile` (3023) | A field fails validation or the model cannot use it. The message names the field and, for modes, the mode. |
| `UnknownDeliveryMode` (3024) | `SetDeliveryModeAsync` names a mode the profile does not define.                                           |
| `AgentVoiceRequired` (3025)  | A speaking workflow was created without a voice, or `SetDeliveryModeAsync` on an agent with no voice.      |
| `AgentBusy` (3004)           | `SetVoiceAsync` while a turn is running.                                                                   |

# TryllVoiceInputComponent

**Type:** `MonoBehaviour`\
**Namespace:** `Tryll.Client`\
**Source:** `Runtime/TryllVoiceInputComponent.cs`

Manages one `TryllVoiceInput` handle and drives it from the Unity `Microphone` API. It captures PCM audio in a coroutine and streams it to the Tryll server for speech-to-text transcription. Transcripts can be forwarded automatically to a [`TryllAgentComponent`](https://docs.tryllengine.com/v0.9/reference/client-api/unity/tryll-agent-component.html).

______________________________________________________________________

## Inspector fields

| Field                 | Type                  | Default                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `modelName`           | `string`              | `"Whisper Tiny EN (int8)"` | STT model catalog name.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `targetAgent`         | `TryllAgentComponent` | —                          | Agent that receives the final transcript. Leave empty for transcribe-only mode.                                                                                                                      |
| `autoFinishOnSilence` | `bool`                | `true`                     | Let the server VAD close the utterance on silence (stop-on-silence mode).                                                                                                                            |
| `maxUtteranceMs`      | `uint`                | `60000`                    | Hard timeout per utterance in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `vadThreshold`        | `float`               | `0.5`                      | Silero VAD speech-probability threshold (0–1).                                                                                                                                                       |
| `vadMinSilenceMs`     | `uint`                | `1000`                     | Silence duration in ms that closes a speech segment. A shorter value splits one spoken sentence at ordinary pauses, and each fragment is then recognized without the context of the rest.            |
| `vadSpeechPadMs`      | `uint`                | `250`                      | Padding in ms added around detected speech.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `hotwordsStoragePath` | `string`              | `""`                       | Relative path (resolved against Storage Data Folder) to a UTF-8 phrase list. Empty disables hotword biasing. Inspector browse uses the same file picker as knowledge-base and canned-response paths. |
| `hotwordsScore`       | `float`               | `1.5`                      | How strongly matched phrases are weighted against one another during beam search. Ignored when `hotwordsStoragePath` is empty.                                                                       |
| `micDeviceName`       | `string`              | `""`                       | Microphone device name. Empty = system default.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `pumpIntervalMs`      | `float`               | `50`                       | PCM pump cadence in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `ringBufferSeconds`   | `int`                 | `2`                        | Microphone ring-buffer length in seconds.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `createOnEnable`      | `bool`                | `true`                     | Create the VoiceInput handle automatically once the `TryllClient` session is ready.                                                                                                                  |

______________________________________________________________________

## Runtime state

```
public TryllVoiceInput Voice       { get; }
public bool HasVoiceInput          { get; }
public bool IsUtteranceActive      { get; }
```

______________________________________________________________________

## Public API

```
// Handle lifecycle
public async void CreateVoiceInput();
public void       DestroyVoiceInput();

// Utterance control
public void BeginUtterance(TryllAgentComponent agentOverride = null);
public void EndUtterance();
public void CancelUtterance();
```

`BeginUtterance` starts the microphone and opens a server-side utterance. When `agentOverride` is given the final transcript is sent to that agent; otherwise `targetAgent` is used. When both are null the component operates in transcribe-only mode.

`EndUtterance` commits the current utterance (push-to-talk release) and stops capture.

`CancelUtterance` discards the current utterance without producing a transcript.

______________________________________________________________________

## Events

| Event                 | Signature                      | Description                                                                                     |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `OnTranscriptUpdate`  | `UnityEvent<TranscriptUpdate>` | Fired for each transcript update (partial and final). Check `update.Kind` for `UtteranceFinal`. |
| `OnError`             | `UnityEvent<TryllError>`       | Fired on protocol-level errors.                                                                 |
| `OnVoiceInputCreated` | `UnityEvent`                   | Fired when the VoiceInput handle is created.                                                    |

______________________________________________________________________

## Capture model

- Microphone starts on `BeginUtterance` and stops when the `UtteranceFinal` arrives (or on `EndUtterance` / `CancelUtterance`). Each turn closes on a non-empty speech final; begin a new utterance for the next turn.
- A coroutine pumps small PCM chunks at `pumpIntervalMs` cadence into the server's audio pipeline.
- The device-native sample rate is declared to the server; the server resamples to the STT model's expected rate.

______________________________________________________________________

## Lifetime and ownership

- The component owns its `TryllVoiceInput` handle and disposes it in `OnDisable` and `OnDestroy`.
- On disconnect the component drops its local state without sending `DestroyVoiceInput` (the TCP connection is gone).
